test_vectors.coverage: Exact raw spans and borrowed ownership
vectors: All seven JSON value tags with leading and trailing whitespace
Empty strings, arrays, and objects
Nested containers whose container index differs from their node ID
Payload pointer identity and preservation of internal whitespace
Null, true, false, exact -0 and 1.2300E+0042 number spellings
Raw UTF-8 for accented, CJK, and non-BMP characters
Every short JSON escape, slash, NUL, U+001F, combining marks, and surrogate pairs
Payload and decoded-arena pointer identity and cloned owner lifetime
Zero, decimal digit boundaries, i64::MIN, i64::MAX, u64::MAX and neighboring values
Signed -0 succeeds; every minus integer spelling fails unsigned conversion with ConstraintViolation
Integer overflow never falls back to floating point in converted
Decimal and exponent spellings, including 1.0, 1e0, -0.0, and -1e0, fail integer conversion with InvalidNumber
256 fixed-seed full-width unsigned and signed integer pairs
Long integer spellings at lengths 19, 20, 21, 31, 32, 63, 64, 127, 128, and 1024

test_vectors.coverage: Correctly rounded binary64 and lexical variant selection
vectors: Positive and negative zero, 0.1, -1.5, and integer rounding around 2^53
Exact halfway ties at 1 plus 2^-53 and 1 plus 3*2^-53, plus a decimal just above a tie
Minimum normal, maximum subnormal, minimum subnormal, and decimals bracketing half the minimum subnormal
Finite underflow with both signs and arbitrarily long exponent spellings
Maximum finite binary64 and adjacent decimal overflow cases
A thousand-digit fractional tail that rounds to exactly 1
U64, I64, and F64Bits selection with preserved signed-zero bits
Wrong-kind access across all JSON kinds, including quoted numbers
Absolute offsets for padded roots and nested conversion failures
Span overflow, out-of-bounds raw and cooked spans, missing tables and metadata
Invalid UTF-8 in raw numeric text, raw strings, and decoded strings
Invalid internal numeric text and unknown or missing node words
Repeated successes and failures leave payload, decoded arena, tables, metadata, and empty numeric caches unchanged
